# Lecture 5 — transcript

¶1 Auzubillah Minashaitan Nirajeem

¶2 Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim

¶3 We were discussing about human soul and the wonders of the creation of Allah which is actually unfathomable. If you remember just a reminder from last week we said that we have aalamul-mulk which is actually surrounded by a bigger aalam or a bigger world of creation, which corresponds to this which is called aalamul-masaal or aalamul-khayaal, the world of image. It is also called barzakh. Now I want to ask you it is called barzakh after mentioning that there's another world which is aalamul-oqul or the world of intellect. They are intellect because they are rational beings like angles. They are called intellect because they are purely reason they do not attach to any material thing. And that's why the world of angels is completely different from the world of human beings.

¶4 Now is aalamul-mulk where we are living now, but it doesn't mean that we will move to another aalam, like aalamul-misaal after death or somewhere else. It is another dimension of the same world in which we are living and also aalamul-oqul as well is another dimension but with some difference. Now this aalmul-misaal is also called aalamul-barzakh. Can anyone tell me why? Barzakh is a barrier or something which goes between 2 things. It is called barzakh because it's a middle world between this aalamul-mulk and aalamul-oqul. Although it's a world of images, but it’s a middle world. A middle world in a sense that although it is detached from the matter that we know however, it carries some qualities of this matter like dimension, like colour, material pleasures which maybe are deceived remedies.

¶5 We have some pleasures which are mentioned in the Quran although they are in aalamul-barzakh or aalamul-misaal. Now, human soul has the capacity to somehow correspond to all these trivial. Well now our soul is completely attached to our body so it is completely aalamul-mulk or it is called aalamul-shahadah. Aalamul-shahadah because we see it. The other worlds above it we don’t see. That is aalamul-ghayb. Its ghayb because this ordinary eye on its own is not perceivable. It needs training to be perceived. So when Allah says he is aalamul-ghayb wa shahadah it means he knows whatever you are in and of course, he is aalamul-ghayb of the other words which are actually like an envelope around this world like a dimension but a much deeper dimension around this world.

¶6 And of course, what happens when we die because when we die we go to this middle world that is aalamul-barzakh, isn’t it? When we die we go to this middle world. Exactly we don’t go anywhere. It’s just we go to the other dimension of this world. Even when we are resurrected, we don’t go anywhere. We just go to another deeper and deeper dimension of tis world which are of course closer and closer to the glory and Jalal and Jamaal of Allah subhanaw taala. Now what happens when we die? We leave this body but we have another body which has dimension and colour. However it’s not matter. It’s not a physical material type of body. It is called the image body or badan-ul-misaali.

¶7 A body which has the image like we have however, it doesn't have matter. It doesn't have any means of elements. It’s not made of elements like how our body is made but is completely similar to this body like its shape in this world. Can anyone tell me when this body is cold for us? A soul needs a body. A soul cannot live without the body. And this is why our capacity to progress is different. The angels cannot progress as they are made because there is no evolution. No change, no movement. Allah has put this soul of human being in some way which can move and change as well. And that's why the expansion is infinite.

¶8 Why? Every angel, every member of this aalamul-oqul, they have a limited amount space. “Wa maa minnaaa illaa lahoo maqaamun ma'loom” 37:164 every member of the angles they have a known position, a limited station. They cannot move above it. They cannot go further except human beings. Mystics say human beings don’t have enough of maqaamun maloom. It is not known for us how far it can go than its time and this is why actually the angels prostrated to Adam because of the capacity that Adam have and they didn’t have. This capacity of course expands by learning the names of Allah. Now, can you tell me when this soul when this misaaale body. Our misaale body is not our soul.

¶9 Soul is something different. And these people who say that bring our soul out of the body of course most of them lie, however when they say we bring our souls out of our body they don’t mean to bring soul out of the body. They somehow separate the 2 bodies from each other in a way that neither of the body dies. When this misaale body is full, which of course you carry on in the barzakh in the middle world, what is it called? That misaale body is with us but we don't see because it is in another dimension of us. If somehow could exactly put upon this body however, it can be separated when we die and there's one suspicious thing about this body.

¶10 In this world of course, when we think too much our faces would show it. I mean for shrewd and intelligent people or faithful people it’s clear. When they see a face they can recognise whether there is faith or no faith while it shows what is in the heart. And if someone who is very, very painful you will see light on their face. It happens. This is something very common. However, of course, this is very limited to those people who can recognise this and also the changes are slow and very small. It doesn’t deform a person or deforms a body. It will have some effect but it doesn’t deform. That misaale body is very sensitive. It is deformed by sins and this is something very interesting because, for example, when you hear that some people say we look at some people and saw them in different faces.

¶11 Some of them were, for example, donkeys. Some of them were monkeys, some of them were other animals like the. Of course they can never recognise who they are, but their misaale body is deformed in a way that they appear in other forms and other shapes and when that body actually separates from this body, it shows itself very much. The meaning of this hadith which is an explanation of this verse “Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja: 78:18 the day the trumpet will be sounded and you will come in different groups. We have in hadith that people will come in different form and shapes. They come in the shape of different animals. It is because their misaali body is deformed.

¶12 It is deformed now I mean and someone who is really pious, their misaali body become shiny. And this is why and of course on the Day of Judgement we have some other body different from this misaali body on the Day of Judgement we are told in the Quran that some faces shine and they have light which actually their faces carry light which would enlighten their way make everything clear for them. “Yawma taral mu'mineena walmu'minaati yas'aa nooruhum baina aydeehim” 56:12 their light goes ahead of them, so shiny their bodies are and of course on the other side the kuffar you see them their faces are dark. “Maa lahum minal laahi min 'aasimin ka annamaaa ughshiyat wujoohuhum qita'an minal laili muzlimaa” 10:27 it is as if their faces are covered by darkness of the night.

¶13 This is how they look. This is how their actions affect the body and those people who say that we see people in different forms, they actually enter into that dimension of the middle world and they see the middle world. It is a very difficult to see the middle world. If you go to that dimension then of course you see the dimension of the middle world. Even in the middle world not all people are able to recognise that deformation of the body.

¶14 Now, if the body is deformed in this way you can imagine how soon it is deformed by sins and how, when, of course until the day of judgement comes how picking the soul would think about themselves when they see the deformation they have brought upon themselves by the actions that they had in this world. We mentioned that the human being if this is our aalamul shahadah, if this is our existence here in this world then our existence in the world of images is much bigger. We may not believe it but when we die and enter the other world, the world of images we will see that this world was a film. It was something that had actually completely restricted our actions our pleasures our understanding.

¶15 And when we go to that middle world, we will see how immense is this capacity in terms of pleasure, enjoyment because the real pleasure is what you feel or how we imagine. And that is the world of imagination. Whatever you imagine is you actually. And of course in jannah it’s the same thing. “Lahum maa yashaaa'oona 'inda Rabbihim” 39:34 “wa hum fee mash tahat anfusuhum” 21:102 whatever your soul might wish is there. And that wish itself is materialisation of itself. When you wish it, it is with you and then when of course we go to the next world we will become much bigger. Of course we can’t call qayamah aalamul-oqul. It’s a bit different. Now when we say this we don't mean that human soul actually is differentiated or divided into the next world.

¶16 It is one thing which can cover on its capacity to connect and communicate with all these worlds. And therefore the mystics say if you want to know the creation of Allah, you have to know your soul. Everything could be known by you however, it is very difficult to get an understanding and knowledge of one's own soul. This I have been quoting from Ayatullah Hasanzadeh Amaouli who is a contemporary aarif and is still alive in Qum. He says in one of his books that the knowledge of soul could not be attained except through inner veils and patience. When you want to know your soul you need visions to see it and this is not of course obtained but by self-training in private and accompanied by strong seclusion from people.

¶17 Of course this seclusion is not physical seclusion. It means seclusion in heart which is of course mentioned in the Quran about the prophet. “Wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa” 73:8 remember the name of your lord and cut off from everyone through him. And we know that prophets physically didn’t cut off. Especially after they were given the mission and this is after the mission he never cut off from people. He was always among the people. So this is a seclusion which goes inside the heart. It is sound seclusion and perseverance from any things of the world and desires. And of course I think this is really difficult to detach oneself from this world and its worries and the type of things which we are used to do is very difficult.

¶18 So whatever we are talking about irfan and other things, talking about it is simple but if you want to put it in practise is difficult and find out however we are going to find about all these things later on when we die, inshaAllah. So you might ask, what’s the point to do all these and make life difficult? Now I will ask you, what’s the point? If you are anyhow going through all these and after you die we go to aalamul-misaal. Why should we say aalamul-misaal? Why should we communicate with aalamul-misaal, the middle world? Now when we die naturally we go to that image world. Of course after that naturally we go higher and higher. Certainly when we go to jannah and you know that the prophets have promised that if you follow and do whatever I tell you without putting so much effort, we will come by your side.

¶19 So what’s the point of all these? Can anyone tell me? I mean after you have done and tried so hard and you have reached to this stage and you have been relieved from the sufferings anyhow, isn’t it? It all goes back to that very famous verse of the Quran “Wassaabiqoonas saabiqoon” 56:10 those who are ahead of others in this world. They are ahead of others in the other world. However unless that drive comes into the heart one cannot start and that drive comes after of course we have proven to Allah that we deserve it. “Zaalika fadlul laahi yu'teehi many-yashaaa” 62:4 this is the grace of god which is for everyone and of course it doesn’t want evil people to travel along this path.

¶20 Now there's another terminology here with the mystics which of course we have covered. Most of it they say Al-insaan nabbiyun wa misaaliyun wa abliyun wa elahi. It is this human soul. It is abli because it is connected to aalamul-shahdah because it's connected to our body and it’s connected to this world and feels the pleasures of this world. It is misaali because it humans khayaal which correspond to aalamul-misaal. Now we have two types of worlds as imagination. One is our imagination which they call it the connected world of image. My imagination is different from yours. However, most of us know that. We have something similar which is imagination. Could we have a world, a dimension of this world which is actually imagination of our imagination is images, isn’t it?

¶21 We have images in our mind when I think imagination I don't mean just wimpy type of contemplation. I have no images in my mind and this is very real. Your image in my mind is very real. It corresponds to me, it corresponds to the outside world however it is in my mind and that’s a world in itself. Now that world corresponds to reality. Could we have a dimension of this world of images independent of mindless people? Is it possible? It exists and that is why you have this world. Actually, this world that you have is just a sample of that world in which the dead people enter and when they die they go into the world of images that is aalamul-misaal and your imagination, again as I said by imagination I don't mean your world of images.

¶22 Images, is something a sample of that world of images and when you can go to that world you see of course. And when you die, you completely go to that world. Now when human intellect corresponds to aalamul-oqul and that intellect, by intellect we mean, we understand meanings that although they correspond to the real world. For example I have an image of you in my mind and an image of you in different images. Now, one intellect when make an understanding which does not exist in real, in the outside world and that is the concept of human being, isn’t it? Human being without a special feature is missed of something in the outside world, a human being without a special feature.

¶23 Of course existed my special feature, you exist your special feature but human being without any special feature does not exist. However your mind can make something which is much higher than this world and that is what the world of intellect is about. About things which does not have special feature which corresponds towards unity and we have that and also a divine aspect which corresponds to human connection above. Apart from these 2 we have a divine aspect and that is what we can direct connect and communicate to Allah. Of course, we are weak but we have the potential and some people have actually realised this potential. We have in hadith that the Prophet said, I have times with god.

¶24 I have hours with god which no one can tolerate to share with me neither a close angel nor a messenger. He has a divine aspect which he realised. And when that divine aspect of the soul is realised then no creature, no animal can ever reach that level of creation of Allah. I have come across a very interesting hadith of immah. I really don't understand the meaning of it. Even after I mean thinking that we come to some sort of view about what this hadith mean. But let's put it in our context. This is from Imam Jafar Sadiq(as) through Abdullah ibne Rahman. He reports from 6^(th) Imam and Abi Abdillah. He says there is not a single jummah night in which there no pleasure of presence of god.

¶25 There is pleasure in jummah nights for us. I said to imam how is this? He said when the night of jummah comes the prophet visits the arsh and the imams do the same and I visited them and I do not return but with learnt knowledge. We have many other hadith that the knowledge of immah increase every night of jummah. Has this not been the case what I have would have been finished or would have been lost in terms of knowledge. And I have to refresh this knowledge every night of jummah by visiting the arsh of Allah. Now tell me what you understand from this hadith? What is the meaning of this hadith in the context of our discussion?

¶26 What do you mean by travel? Your body or your soul doesn’t travel. And you go and travel into your soul. And the soul is a place or the heart of a momin is a place of Allah. And you go and search in the eyes of your own soul. It is as if you go to the arsh of Allah. It is just like walking inside deeper and deeper. When the prophet visited the arsh, of course the prophet doesn’t go anywhere. It is actually that connection, conjunction which takes place between the soul of the prophet and of course the arsh of Allah. But you may say this is not all the time the case. It is not all the time connected and only on laylatul jummah.

¶27 If it is all the time connected it will burn. It is not easy. Sometimes our blessed hours, blessed time happens and this is the meaning of the hadith. I mean if you put the hadith in this context all of them find the meaning. Your Lord in the times of your life there are some times he exposes you. There are times he attacks you and then leaves you because that attack you cannot be in constant attraction. Your soul needs to breathe and then go again. You have to come, take it and go again. This happens with the prophet and his knowledge expands. Although he is there by visiting the arsh and the living imam as well expands his knowledge by visiting the arsh because that is the intimate site of receiving knowledge.

¶28 Regarding the prophet going to meraj, the mystics say that it wasn’t physical. It was physical from Mecca to Masjid-e-Aqsa but when it higher, it was not with the physical. It was just the movement of the soul visiting the world of wonders of the afterlife and the world of Allah. I want to ask another question. You must have heard in hadith that a Quran has a zahir and a batin. It has 7 depths and each the 7 depths, there are another 70 depths and so on. Now what's the name of this putting it into the context of our discussion? Quran itself is not something if could have deeper layers. It’s our soul which has deeper layers and when we come across different things for example when a verse we recite we understand with the depth of our soul and then of course someone who has a different depth of the soul, they get to deeper meaning of that one verse and everything is like this.

¶29 There is a very interesting hadith which is often quoted by mystics and I witness for what they say. The hadith is reported by both Shia and Sunnis scholars and it is reported from the prophet and immah. On the day of judgement when we go to paradise, we are told to recite a verse and go up. And a person would go higher in accordance with number of verses of the Quran that he knows. Read and go up. You you can imagine that if you want to somehow materialize that imagining in a material form you can imagine that there are 1000s of stairs and they put you on the first stair and they tell you Okay, read as many verses of the Quran that know and go up and of course if I know 2 verses of the Quran and you go up 2 steps.

¶30 And now Quran has above 6000 verses. It doesn't mean that there are 6000 stairs only. It is the depth of the verse that you read purely and accordingly you go up. It's not memorization of the verses, it’s not the verses that you know by number but it’s the depth by which you have internalised in your soul because as the mystics say this book is your soul and the deeper you get into it the more developed is your soul. The more you actually expand and this is the meaning of the hadith that on the Day of Judgment you read and you go up. I think 100s of hadith you can read into this context and this is of course a forceful argument for all mystics that we can explain many of these hadiths otherwise, we are in trouble.

¶31 If you wants to explain this hadith in a physical way, or in other ways then you are in trouble. You then use a superficial mechanical way or you don’t understand except if you have knowledge of how human soul is related and connected to the different world. Then of course, it doesn't stop. When you say human soul or human being is misaaliyun wa aqaliyun wa elahi this is a very broad category covered with different depths which is the soul. Now let's see what else they say. They say there is a great ruh which is ruhul aazam. Of course there are other ruh but there is a ruhul aazam which Allah attributes to himself. In fact someone asked one of the immah , does Allah have ruh?

¶32 He said of course Allah doesn’t have ruh because Allah is not composed. However like Allah made Kaaba his house because this house is so dignified by Allah that he attributed it to him. Or when he says rasool, my messenger is the same thing. My messenger is so dignified that I attribute him to myself and this ruh as well is a dignified ruh which is the greatest creation of Allah and he had actually reserved this for human beings to blow into the human soul. This ruhul aazam which has come to us, it comes down to the nafs. Our nafs of course might be very evil like nafsul aamara. We had discussed about nafsul ammara, nafsul lavvama and nafsul mutmainnah.

¶33 It is like nafsul ammara however this is very much diluted aspect of that ..which of course this nafs can identify that evil things by a mechanism which we do not understand and his creation which is full of wonders. They say ruhul aazam has many different names. This ruhul aazam has a layer which is called Al-Serr. It is secret because it is not known but to Allah. That's why it's called serr. Although it is secret it could be experienced by rafeeqqon al ilm, by the knowledgeable people which we see the soul glowing inside them which illuminates the whole mind and heart understanding. Then there is another layer of the soul which is al-mukhtafi meaning hidden. It is hidden because the reality of it is not known to anyone even to the angels.

¶34 The reality is very difficult to understand. “Wa yas'aloonaka 'anirrooh; qulir roohu min amri rabbee wa maaa ooteetum minal 'ilmi illaa qaleelaa” 17:85 they don’t have knowledge about this. The knowledge is only with Allah. It is a knowledge which is kept for him about the reality of ruh and if you go to the world of urafa and those who have actually realised this knowledge you will find they say that how this ruh was created is very difficult to understand even with unveiling you cannot see. You cannot see the reality. Now you can imagine this ruh which can somehow elevate human being through the level of arsh or even we can have the arsh inside of our heart.

¶35 Imagine how Allah will elevate human being like us and how this soul which is a great mystery of Allah is created by this. “Maa khalqukum wa laa ba'sukum illaa kanafsinw-waa hidah” 31:28 and your creation or your resurrection is in no wise but as an individual soul. Of course the bodies are reproduced but what about your soul? Are they reproduced as well? They are created by him of course, but that souls are reproduced by that very soul which is our nafs. When they say one other layer is the lower layer, we call it Ar-Ruh. Of course it is a sub-branch of the great ruh which we call ruh. They call it ruh the spirit because it gives spirit to the body and manages human soul and body, the human nafs.

¶36 And actually it’s like god in our body. The mystics say that there is a bond between human soul and body like how Allah controls this world. We have this name mentioned for Allah in Jawshan-e-kabeer and other dua “ya mal-la yash-ghaluhu sam-u'n `an sam-i`in” O He-listening to one individual does not prevent Him from listening to others simultaneously. Infact Allah is at the same time “wa maa tasqutu minw waraqatin illaa ya'lamuhaa” 6:59 and not a leaf falls but He knows it. Actually he does this but we do not see his action here but actually he does it. Now they say human soul is the same thing. Ruh soul is actually controlling your body and at the same time we do many things.

¶37 Now at this moment when I am talking to you imagine how many organs and parts of my body are controlled by my soul so that I can express myself when my body, my hand, my tongue especially I try to find words for my concepts, to bring the concepts. Imagine something and find concepts for it and find words for those concepts and then ordering my tongue to move accordingly. My eyes are moving constantly. Everything is controlled at the same time by the soul. Now if your soul expands and expands ..different type of knowledge we have at the same time. Sometimes we hear the miracle about prophet and immah .. your soul.. and you might have heard of some mystics for example, when you go to them they give you something to eat.

¶38 For example, when sick people go to them, they give a date or something, you eat them and you become ok. It’s not that date which is actually helping. It is their soul which is somehow acting smoother. It is very interesting. Those of you who have been to Mashad, last time when we had been to Mashad and visited the tomb of Shaikh Hasan Ali Nokhodaki. He was a miraculous type of aarif and of course he had done lot of qaramat and all of these. Once people went to him and he told them something to eat for cancer and other incurable diseases. He just gave advices very easily. One day someone went to him, wife of French and show us who you are.

¶39 The French man had some incurable disease. Of course the husband couldn’t go to Mashad especially in the midst of those days about 60-70 years ago and the wife went to Mashad to visit this aalim and told him that my husband is dying in pain. He told her, is your husband believer in god? She said certainly we are Christians and we believe in god. He said ok, you take this stick and give him to eat. He will be ok. She said I fear if I go there he is already dead. So the aalim said ok you eat and he will be ok. She was surprised. How is it possible? I eat and how can he get well?

¶40 And surprisingly when ate and went back she saw the husband got cured. This is something which is very strange and unbelievable. This is something that ordinary mystics can’t do certainly. There are categories of mystics. Some can do miracles and some cannot. Some can only see and some can only do while some can do both. Of course we will come to these later on InshaAllah. But this was something very strange. It is just the expansion of the soul which can control and in fact your soul cannot control your own body. Their soul manages your body. Sometimes they are not allowed, allowed in the sense that they are not given the power. It is like dua. All of us have the ability to do dua but sometimes it doesn't work.

¶41 This very person which I am talking about was living at the time of Raza Shah was a cruel person who made majalis for Imam Hussain forbidden in Iran. He actually banned hijab and took hijab from every woman in the street and of course many other things. No one could have any majlis for Imam Hussain at that time even in their houses and our fathers when they talk about those days, if they heard somebody is having majalis suddenly the whole police force would have come and arrested everyone. They were not allowed. Now people went to this Hasan Ali asking that if he could do anything about this man.

¶42 You have power; god has given you this power so do something. So he said ok and of course people saw that some change came. And after a while they went to him and said, you did this? He said I tried but our soul.. .I mean god has this wisdom of course he is not going to put it in the hands of this kind of people and when he .. of course not even mystics, not even prophets can interfere. When it is not their business, it is not their business when they can’t do anything about it. With Yaqub of course sometimes these people are so..if they get cured again they go blind as it was the case of Shoaib for example because he could not control himself.

¶43 In case of Yaqub he never told that he wants to get cured or he had ever spoken about it. He was so consoled in the heart. But after that Yusuf’s shirt or whatever “Izhaboo biqameesee haazaa fa alqoohu” 12:93 his shirt when came is the same thing actually. It cured the eyes and of course that was because then he smelled the fragrance of Yusuf. He was relieved in the heart and was cured somehow. And then after this spirit we have the “Al-Qalb”. This qalb, aql all these are aspects of our soul. “Lahum quloobuny ya'qiloona bihaaa” 21:46 their hearts did not understand. There are own aspects of our soul. It is called qalb because it changes all the time and especially with mystics can change faith towards god and towards this world.

¶44 It receives from god and it turns and attends to the body and actually can benefit from both sides. And then it is called al-kalimah “innamal Maseehu 'Eesab-nu-Maryama Rasoolul laahi wa Kalimatuhooo” 4:171 when god uses kalimah here of course they say this is referred to one aspect or level of the soul, the lowest because it spells out the intensions of Allah that's why it is called kalimah and every creation of Allah is called kalimah because it spells out what Allah wants to create and what he realises. Then they say there's another aspect of this ruh which is called “Al-Faad” “waj'alnaa lahum sam'anw wa absaaranw wa af'idatan” 46:26 Afidah is the plural of faad. Faad is impressed while faadah means to be injured, to be impressed by something.

¶45 And faad is that aspect of the soul which gets really impressed by looking into the world of Allah. And then it is also called “As-Sabr” the issuing because it is from the sabr which of course the understanding about Allah is issued in the light of the ruh comes to the body, the light of Allah comes to the body from the soul and that is the sabr from which issues or comes out all those shining and it is called “Ar-Ruh” because it fears Allah. We have a hadith from the prophet, the ruhul quddus blew into my inner soul. No one will die until they see completely what the world was destined for them. So do not worry.

¶46 Of course the prophet said but we do not believe. And then because it is through this soul that we understand and then we have “An-Nafs”. Of course nafs is a more general term used when we talk about the totality of this human soul. But it is a whole aspect or manifestations of that ruh that Allah has actually blown into the human existence because there is a human body because after this body vanishes, the ruh still exists. It is blown into human existence or human creation. Now this nafs is called nafsul ammara is the physical aspect of human beings overcome the spiritual aspect and then since the soul wants to actually gain benefits from the physical aspects, pleasures then of course it is nafsul ammara.

¶47 It is the same nafs, we don't have different types of nufus. It is all the same thing depending on the attitude and that’s why we can change the attitude. When we change our attitude of the nafs, we change the name of the nafs. If after this overcoming of the physical aspect of soul or a human being over the spiritual aspect, the soul remembers or give reminder and then blames why I have done this. This blaming of the soul is a very important sign which we do not prolong because we blame ourselves for it. It means we have other ambitions other concepts which are more valued for us. And when we let the physical aspects overcome the spiritual aspects or that higher valued aspects, we start blaming ourselves.

¶48 And that is called nafsul lavvama or the blaming aspect. Now if you continue blaming yourself and thinking what you have been doing, it comes a time that you realise that you're no more controlled by your intellect or your physical world. There comes a stage that to heal you are completely relying on what belongs to the other world and not this world. This is the stage that the nafs becomes be relieved, becomes tranquil and this is called nafsul-mumainnah. It is completely relieved of the world which comes with sin, which comes with greed, comes with diversion of all attentions towards the physical aspect of this life. It is all about it. When I say physical aspect of course it is not just immediate physical pleasures.

¶49 There are many other things. You worry about your children, about their future not in terms of training but you worry about they might get poor or what am I going to do next year for example if I don’t have a good job. These are of course not the very immediate pleasure. However these are the physical aspects of life which are controlled by our soul. It is actually pressures the soul, it doesn’t let it to leave and go off go higher and connect to Allah because it is all the time worried about the body. The body is totality of course now tomorrow next year his own body, relatives physical life and all these things. It doesn't let you to leave this aspect and of course the soul is very habitable to the physical world.

¶50 It will become habituated very quickly. If you train, all the time worry about the body, if you train it then it worries about higher things and then of course it will see the light. At one depth it is completely occupied with organising the pleasures of this body. It cannot go higher. Now there's one thing about Ramadan which I'm going to mention in the next programme.

¶51 This fasting of Ramadan of course the fast in Ramadan many different philosophies are mentioned. However, what is important in Ramadan in laylatul qadr angels come down. That’s very special. Whole of Ramadan there are lights of Allah everywhere. It is just like a big meadow in which there are different types of flowers and when you walk into it you get the fragrance of that meadow. The soul in this month is actually exposed to this ziyafatullah. Allah has actually abundantly poured down light over the soul. Now of course, if we do not fast your soul is very much again occupied with your body. The least of this is the digestion of the soul. I mean even the physical aspects are managed by the soul.

¶52 The least of this is digestion of the soul, thinking about food. Even when we fast we are thinking about iftaar and all these things in these hours where the soul is less affected by the body. Even unknowingly those fragrances, light which are everywhere in Ramadan are accepted by the soul. However if you do not fast the soul cannot get that light. This is a type of philosophy of the fasts of course could not be explained very easily, except by knowing how what is the relation of the soul to the body and how soul can be very much affected. In fact some action completely.. the soul and the soul completely becomes overwhelmed by the physical aspect.

¶53 For example salatul layl, is very much helpful to release itself from the discomfort of the body and of course see the light. I think I conclude the topic of the soul by saying that human soul is a mystical literature which can be as big as arsh of Allah. And this is something which we can lose very easily by occupying with the type of life which really it does not deserve. It doesn’t go with its position, the position of the soul. And this is the meaning of those verses which we mentioned at the beginning of the topic when we spoke about the soul that “allazeena khasirooo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon” 6:20 those who have lost their own souls refuse therefore to believe.

¶54 Or you forget Allah, you lose your soul. The other way of saying is that you completely divert your attention to this world. Your soul is overwhelmed, it is subdued and you do not see because it is very small. If you talk in a type of physical sense, the soul is like a very fine elastic material. You could just hold in a way that you have to just hold in your hand and you could let it expand as it becomes the size of the universe. It is a very amazing thing. If sometimes you see this fictional very amazing thing made about some capacity of some people. You might imagine if you want to make a film on this it will become very interesting.

¶55 Experience something to be placed in the palm of the hand and how you could make it expand to be the size of the universe. And this is human soul. This is an amazing thing. “Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa” 91:7 I swear by the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it. And the funny thing is that it is ordained to us and I don’t know whether god didn't know how silly we are. Sometimes we see that how is it possible that this is entrusted to us in a very short time to do whatever we want to. Actually it would become very frightening when we think about it. What is entrusted or what is given to us?

¶56 And of course what we do with it and of course whatever we do with it, would remain with us forever. The soul would shape and fashion in this world forever the way we fashion it, the way we make it. Soul have millions of …and meditation in fact many people might talk about meditation and mystical experience. They really don't know what level they are talking about and how deep the can go. What depth of the soul they can find. The only thing is that we know meditation is not about going anywhere. It just reflecting inside the soul and it cannot be done by just not thinking about anything or sitting still. We know that zikrullah is very important for meditation.

¶57 It is by zikrullah that the soul is refreshed and revived. “Ala bi zikrillahi tatmainul quloob” 13:28. If you want nafsul mutmainnah, qalb is nafs. If you are nafsul mutmainnah, only remembrance of God can give you peace. nafsul mutmainnah. After nafsul mutmainnah then you can start to see your soul and to reach that level of nafsul mutmainnah itself is a task. Those who forget god, Allah have made them to forget their soul is in fact telling us that if you do not remember god you can never get to know your soul. Is it possible? So by meditation in a way nowadays we have like just sit somewhere, do think about anything, suspend yourself completely you might get somewhere but it’s very shallow.

¶58 It’s just a distraction from the world. It is good at that level but not real knowledge comes out of it which of course the real mystics have, the real knowledge. The mystics say that ruhul quddus is again one category of this ruh when it gets very close to Allah we call it ruhul quddus. Infact when we have ruhul quddus, our ruh of course the prophets identified them in depth which is very close to Allah and that is why they can connect to that ruh. The connection is in a way that their ruh becomes identified with that ruhul quddus. And again it is one deeper level of our soul. Of course high level prophets can reach that level.

¶59 Human being is connected to only one ruh. However there must be other ruh that we are not aware which are not connected to this ruh which is human ruh.

¶60 Wa sallahu ala mohammadin wa aale hittahereen.
